scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @erp/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @erp/api" "npm run dev -w @erp/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @erp/api && npm run lint -w @erp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @erp/api && npm run typecheck -w @erp/web
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @erp/api && npm run build -w @erp/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @erp/api && npm run test -w @erp/web
